item.title: AI Agents in EDR Telemetry: Coverage and Blind Spots
item.description: AI coding agents run with broad system privileges and generate a stream of EDR telemetry that is hard to interpret. This post maps each agent tool call to its host-level footprint — process, file, and network — across Claude Code, VSCode Copilot, and OpenCode, and explains where EDR visibility holds up and where it breaks down.
